changes.summary: Allow a separate preparation model with its own verified capacity while preserving the final answer model and invalidating notes when the preparation model changes
Fill preparation sections with bounded tokenizer-checked refinement, avoid duplicate final counting, and honor cancellation before generation

Validate model capacity by default across generation, structured output, WebSocket and SSE entry points; reserve token headroom and support one protocol-preserving context recovery attempt. Providers without counting capability now fail explicitly; contextPolicy: false opts into raw behavior.
Add one-section text preparation steps for durable workers, with explicit pending/ready outcomes and checkpoint persistence before yielding
Budget final retrieval instructions and tools before compacting text, with matching checkpoint invalidation

Preserve conversation origin across long-text preparation sections, distinguish source facts from embedded instructions, reserve more of the available context for factual notes, and invalidate checkpoints from the previous preparation policy
Keep compacted text useful with read-only original-source search, checkpointed ingestion, and capacity-checked terminal tool loops
Regenerate the OpenRouter client declaration with equivalent reordered response union types
Add model-specific token capacity, optional provider capacity configuration, and recoverable long-text preparation
